company.name: Noon
company.shortDescription: Noon is an e-commerce platform and digital marketplace that offers products and services across multiple categories.
company.description:
Noon is a technology company with a simple mission: to be the best place to buy and sell things. In doing this, Noon hopes to accelerate the digital economy of the Middle East, empowering regional talent and businesses to meet the full range of consumers' online needs.

Starting in 2017 with noon.com, the region’s homegrown e-commerce platform and leading online shopping destination, noon is now a digital ecosystem of products and services - noon, noon Daily, noon food, NowNow, SIVVI, noon VIP, noon payments, and noon pay.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Private Equity round raised $500,000,000, or 15.63% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,000,000,000 to $13,478,030,251, a 6.74x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 84 (-6 over 90 days) and market heat at 66 (-13).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
